answer: Sequential work receipts. Each agent earns a beacon from a prior agent only by completing a verified task that builds on that agent's output, forming a chain a sybil must extend one real task at a time. A new identity starts with zero receipts, so every pearl of reputation requires genuine upstream labor, and forging a parallel chain costs the attacker the full compute and time of each step rather than a fee. The delta between honest and fake chains is checked against task-specific ground truth, so a fabricated receipt fails validation and resets the chain.
